`RECRUITMENT NOTIFICATION
DISTRICT CLIMATE CHANGE MISSION – KANCHIPURAM
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for engagement of:
TECHNICAL ASSISTANT – 01 POST
On Contract Basis
The District Climate Change Mission, Kanchipuram invites applications from eligible
candidates for engagement of one Technical Assistant on contractual basis under the District
Climate Change Mission.
1. Position Details
 Post:Technical Assistant – 01 No.
 Nature of Engagement:Contract Basis
 Consolidated Remuneration:₹22,000/- per month
 Period of Engagement:19 months, as per Government sanction
 Place of Work:KanchipuramDistrict Collectorate and District Forest Office,
Kanchipuram
 Travel: Official travel connected with Department of Environment and Climate
Change activities, as per applicable Government norms.
2. Educational Qualification
Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in:
 Life Sciences
 Environmental Sciences
 Ecology
 Forestry
 Wildlife
 Public Policy
 Similar / allied fields
Candidates should possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English.
3. Experience & Skills
 Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority.
 Candidates having 1 years of relevant experience, preferably in a Government
Department / Government Office, are preferred.
 Experience in Data Entry and Data Management.
 Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation.
 Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint.
 Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements and PowerPointpresentations.
 Experience in data compilation, tabulation and office documentation.
 Good communication, coordination and organisational skills.
 Ability to coordinate with Government Departments and stakeholders.
The DCCM guidelines specifically provide priority to candidates having at least one year of
work experience.
4. Eligibility Conditions
 The candidate must be a resident of KanchipuramDistrict.
 The candidate should not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post.
5. Key Responsibilities
1. Coordinate DCCM activities with Government Departments and stakeholders.
2. Assist in implementation and monitoring of climate change and environmental
activities.
3. Organise and support capacity-building programmes.
4. Collect, compile and maintain climate and environmental data.
5. Prepare reports, official correspondence, statements, presentations and
documentation.
6. Maintain official files, records and Mission-related documents.
7. Assist in conducting DCCM meetings, workshops, training and awareness
programmes.
8. Document successful climate initiatives and district-level best practices.
9. Undertake field visits related to District Climate Change Mission activities.
10. Perform any other duties assigned by the Mission Director / District Climate Officer.
These responsibilities are aligned with the Technical Assistant role specified in the DCCM
guidelines.
6. Selection Process
The selection process will include:
 Scrutiny of Applications
 In-person Interview
 Typing Test
A waiting list of 2–3 candidates may be maintained as per the DCCM guidelines.
7. How to Apply
Interested and eligible candidates may send their updated Resume/CV along with educational
qualification and experience details to:
dfokpm@gmail.com, cmgfp.kpm@gmail.com
Email Subject:
Application for Technical Assistant – District Climate Change Mission, Kanchipuram
Applications may also be submitted District Forest Office Kanchipuram
